notes.title: Hotfix - Bioguard 1.0.14
notes.notes:
[b][General][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed skill tree bug that corrupted the save in versions 1.0.13.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - Bioguard 1.0.12
notes.notes:
[b][General][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the debuff system in towers on certain occasions.
[*] Fixed the goroguinhos spawn in phase 1 of world 2.
[*] Fixed the refund system in the immunobolto store.
[*] Fixed the order of skills in the phase when configuring the deck.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the game time to be changed at inappropriate times.
[*] Fixed the options panel in the title.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added a feedback animation to new enemy alerts.
[*] Added support for changing gameplay times on the Numpad.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - Bioguard 1.0.11
notes.notes:
[b][General][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed visual effects for healing enemies.
[/list]

[b][Achievements][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the damage and death counter for the “Immuno-Overdrive” ability.
[*] Fixed the activation condition for some achievements.
[/list]

[b][Balancing][/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the damage, cooldown, and stun effect of the munizolic Hero.
[/list]
